title: The Greenhouse Project
description: A quiet botany student struggles to save a dying rare orchid before the spring exhibition, learning patience over perfection.
character_reference: a tall teenager with messy dark curls, wearing a canvas utility apron over a worn green hoodie

scenes.narration: The petal curled inward, brown at the edge, signaling another failed attempt to revive the rare orchid.
scenes.visual: Macro shot of a trembling hand gently touching a drooping yellowish orchid petal under dim fluorescent workbench lights

scenes.narration: Every textbook said to increase nitrogen, but the soil felt heavy and suffocated under the rigid schedule.
scenes.visual: Overhead view of scattered botany textbooks open to complex chemical charts next to a dirty ceramic pot

scenes.narration: Instead of forcing the routine, I decided to observe what the plant actually needed in this damp corner.
scenes.visual: Medium close-up peering through foggy glass panes at rain dripping down outside the potting shed window

scenes.narration: I flushed the soil with tepid water and moved it away from the direct heater vent.
scenes.visual: Close-up of water droplets trickling through dark rich soil inside a cracked terracotta container

scenes.narration: For three days, nothing changed. The silence in the glasshouse felt heavier than the humidity.
scenes.visual: Low angle shot looking upward through hanging fern baskets toward condensation pooling on wooden rafters

scenes.narration: Then, on the fourth morning, a tiny green shoot uncurled toward the soft dawn light.
scenes.visual: Macro photography focusing on a miniature bright green sprout emerging from the damp stem

scenes.narration: It wasn't about control or strict formulas anymore, just listening to the pace of living things.
scenes.visual: Close-up profile of a smiling face lit by warm morning sunshine filtering through dense foliage

scenes.narration: If you are learning to grow at your own pace, follow along for more stories.
scenes.visual: Wide angle shot of a peaceful indoor jungle filled with hanging plants and dappled sunbeams
